subject: general
question: Where is the 22nd All India Annual TDS Conference being held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhopal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Bhopal is hosting the 22nd All India Annual TDS Conference, organised by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The 22nd TDS Conference is being held in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Senior CBDT officials, including the Chairman, are inaugurating the event.
 
• Key focus areas include amendments in the Income Tax Act, 2025, especially revised TDS provisions.
 
• The conference also highlights digital tools like automated TDS tracking and analytics dashboards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **CBDT**__

 __
 
• Apex body administering direct taxes in India.
 
• Responsible for policy formulation, implementation, and enforcement.
 
• Organises annual TDS conferences to review compliance and strengthen systems.
 
 
 
• **TDS (Tax Deducted at Source)**__
 __
 
• Mechanism ensuring tax collection at the time of income generation.
 
• Recent amendments aim to simplify compliance and reduce litigation.
 
• Critical for transparency and voluntary tax culture.
 
 
 
• **Digital Initiatives**__
 __
 
• Automated TDS monitoring systems under implementation.
 
• Data-driven analytics to identify mismatches and compliance gaps.
 
• Online platforms designed for faster grievance redressal.
 
 
 
• **Key Participants**__
 
 
• Principal Chief Commissioners, Chief Commissioners, DGs, and senior TDS officers.
 
• Provide policy inputs and discuss nationwide compliance challenges.
 
• Focus on implementing new compounding guidelines effectively.
